text:
maria: Heads-up — Rival 'FluxAI' just announced a low-latency SLA + predictive autoscaling for reserved pools. Several customers pinged us asking how this affects our Dedicated roadmap. Do we reprioritize autoscaling improvements or push our differentiator work (structured tool-calls + quality guards)?
liam: @maria quick read: autoscaling infra (fast scale-up) is painful but bounded. We can ship a trimmed MVP in 2 sprints if we postpone UI polish and advanced burst policies.
anya: Customer research signal: enterprises prioritize predictability for revenue apps. But developer teams care about deterministic tool-calling and function outputs when integrating with product logic. Both are asked for.
sara: Top 3 trial accounts explicitly called out: model pinning + canary. They said latency guarantees are negotiable if rollouts are safe. This feels like a sales vs infra tradeoff.
maria: Proposal: split into two parallel scopes — (A) Autoscale MVP (infra-first, basic routes) 2 sprints; launch criteria: p95 < 450ms for 8k token tokens burst and successful canary in 3 accounts. (B) Differentiator bet: structured tool-calls + output validation -> 4 sprints, productized evals. Comments?
liam: Practical ask: we need to define the autoscale fallback policy. If we fail to meet p95 we must auto-fail to a lower-cost variant. Suggest config like: 
```
rollout: autoscale-mvp
  scale_up_threshold: 70%
  max_scale_time: 60s
  fallback_model: t0-small
```
anya: For the differentiator, let's attach two eval suites: developer flows and safety flows. Launch criteria could be: pass rate >= 95% on dev flows, and no regressions on safety testset. Also need canary rollout docs for customers.
sara: Sales asks we include an 'enterprise toggle' for immediate model pinning + SLA opt-in. That unlocks ability to lock version and config per-tenant. Big close win.
maria: OK tradeoff meeting tomorrow 10am. Agenda: scope cut options, resource split, go/no-go metrics. Please add pre-reads: current autoscale tech plan (liam), eval plan (anya), enterprise toggle spec (sara).
liam: Added tech plan gist: https://internal.githb/infra/autoscale-mvp (draft) :thumbsup:
anya: I'll attach eval checklist to the doc before EOD.
kevin-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to account-phi at 1765009600 — health checks OK.
sara: If canary looks green, I'll push one-week time-boxed negotiation with the accounts to surface exact SLA wording.
maria: Thanks. Quick decision notes for tomorrow: 1) autoscale MVP scope = infra + basic routing only, no self-serve UI; 2) differentiator ship delayed but parallel R&D; 3) enterprise toggle as precondition for large deals. If anyone disagrees, flag now.
liam: ack.
anya: ack.
sara: ack.
kevin-bot: reminder: retro notes template created at /docs/roadmap/retro-autoscale.
